title: 第5章 挑战
content_zh:
深夜，山林中的一座高山的山巅之上，闪烁着一阵青芒，远远处看去，有如一颗星辰降临山巅一般。为了避免修炼引发的异象被人发现，沈翔借采药为由，来到偏远的山林中修炼

沈翔为了能摄取更多的灵气，为了能感应到天地间的风和雷，他爬到了山巅之上，此时只见山巅之上的云层翻腾起来，狂风大作，偶尔之间云层闪烁出一道道雷电，雷电直落而下，打在山巅之上，仿佛要把山巅劈开一般。

这种惊人的异象正是沈翔修炼青龙神功引发的。狂风，天雷闪电都是他修炼了一整天所引来的，此刻雷电劈打在他的身体之上，不但能淬炼他的身体，同时还能让他摄取强悍的雷电之力入体。

这种举动可谓是疯狂，要知道雷电那大自然最具毁灭力的一种天象，纵使是迈入真武之境的高强武者都不敢随意面对，但沈翔修炼的青龙神功却需要用天雷辅助。

这番奇异景象一直持续到半夜才停止，而沈翔那张因为承受痛苦而扭曲的脸也慢慢恢复了过来，他身上的衣服早已被劈得稀巴烂，而且还有着许多焦黑冒烟的伤痕，不过在那些伤痕上面都闪烁着青光，青光冒着浓郁的木属性气息，修复着伤势。

“这点痛苦算得了什么？我要强大起来！”沈翔双拳紧握，心中呐喊着，忍受着那一波一波的雷击，咬牙忍受着痛苦，让雷电淬炼着他的躯体。

不愧是神功，不但能引发异象，还能让身体承受得住雷电的劈打，打熬肉身，让肉身更加强壮。

几天过去，沈翔的身体被雷电仿佛劈打着，此时他已经完成了基础淬体！

沈翔双目一张，两道雷电从那双坚毅的眸子中迸发而出，煞是惊人。

“神功就是神功，果然不是那些凡俗武功能够比拟的！仅是一个月，就让我进入了凡武境五重！”

沈翔内视着丹田中的五个真气漩涡，只要再壮大一些，能让他随心操控真气，这就是凡武境五重的真气境！

他十六岁，拥有凡武境五重的实力，也算是天才了！

沈翔看着双手上面冒出的一红一青的真气，一个是火属性真气，一个是木属性的真气。说明他已经初步掌握了青龙神功和朱雀神功。

沈翔此时只觉得自己如同脱胎换骨一般，无论是肉身还是真气，都强横无比，毕竟那可是修炼神功凝聚出来的真气，修炼神功淬炼出来的身体。

这时候沈翔才明白神功为什么是神功，就是能让人修炼成神的功法！

“这里灵气太差了，你想要突飞猛进的话，只能通过丹药！你现在能释放出真气之火，可以开始学习炼丹了。”苏媚瑶给他传音道。

苏媚瑶和白幽幽也希望沈翔能快点成长起来，这样她们也能早日恢复实力，没有任何力量的处境让她们感到恐惧。

“哟，这不是沈大公子吗？药家的天才炼丹师对你发出挑战，说要和你比拼炼丹术和比武。”

沈翔刚刚跨入沈家大门，就看见一个满脸傲慢的少年对他说道。

“挑战？什么时候的事情？”沈翔心中惊讶，他可是出去了十来天。

那少年不屑地笑道：“原来你是不知道，我们还以为你是怕才躲起来的！这是十天前的事情，谁让你那未婚妻被人家药家天才看中了？这下你倒霉了。”

沈翔有想揍人的冲动，但他却忍了下来，笑道：“沈振华，你还记得你小时候被我摔得个狗吃屎吗？你现在来该不会是要想看我出丑吧？”

这少年名叫沈振华，是沈家一个分支统领的儿子，沈家的分支很多，遍布南武国各地，那些统领也十分强悍，只有一些重要的事情他们才会聚集到这沈家山庄中的。

沈振华脸上满是怒气，但他却忍了下来，讥笑道：“当然是来看看你怎么被药家天才打垮，我很想看看你是怎么输掉那貌若天仙的未婚妻。”

沈翔低哼了一声，快步离开，去寻找他父亲，他在回来的路上，就听说沈家出事了，所以那些分支统领会回来。

沈翔匆匆的跑了进来，急忙问道：“老爹，爷爷他退下族长的位置了，这是真的吗？”

沈天虎神情凝重，点头道：“是真的！你爷爷他隐退了，他应该去寻访那些武道门派了。沈家分支的统领都会陆续抵达这里争夺族长之位。”

沈家族长退位，这意味着要选出新的族长来，到时候可能会发生许多事情，因为历年来沈家选族长都会发生许多争斗，受伤在所难免。

当上武道世家的族长，能掌握至高无上的权力，拥有丰厚的资源，是许多人拼死都要争夺的。

沈翔的父亲也会争夺族长之位，到时候沈翔定然会被卷入，如果他没有实力的话，那可是相当危险的。

沈家的族长位置从来不传承，都是依靠争夺而来的，毕竟这是一个实力为尊的世界，只有展现强悍的实力才能让别人信服，所以要当沈家族长，就得以武服人。

沈翔看见沈天虎的脸色很凝重，小心问道：“老爹……很棘手吗？”

沈天虎轻叹一声，说道：“很棘手，和我争夺族长之位的人会有好几个，其中有两兄弟是我最顾忌的……不说这个了，药家的天才向你发出挑战了，你去拒绝他吧。”

拒绝？沈翔从得知挑战的事情之后就没有想过要拒绝，他现在可是凡武境五重的武者，而且还身怀神功，因为他修炼太极神功能内敛气息，所以沈天虎不能发现自己儿子突飞猛进

“老爹，我绝不能让薛家和药家小看！我要应战！”沈翔目光坚定，目含战意，身上顿时冒出一股浑厚精纯的真气，这让沈天虎瞳孔收缩，心中震惊，他能从那股真气看出他儿子今非昔比。

沈天虎能想到自己的儿子一定发生了什么，但他也不多问，能看见自己的儿子强大起来他自己也很高兴。

沈天虎的大手搭在沈翔的肩膀上，大笑道：“老爹支持你，一定要让药家天才知道什么叫天外有天！”

沈翔干笑道：“老爹，那你能支持我点钱吗？”

沈翔虽然有一个厉害的父亲，但他自己却很穷，而且他父亲担心他会变成纨绔，所以一直都让他过着朴素的生活，才导致堂堂的族长孙子看起来很落魄。

沈天虎虽然厉害，但为了提升自己的实力，为了帮助沈翔收集丹药，也花了不少，所以他不准沈翔乱花钱。

“我想买点灵药来种植。”沈翔低声说道，眼珠转动着。

种植灵药，那可是非常需要经验的活，而且需要精心照料，一般种植灵药的人，也都是炼丹之人，都是一些头发白花花的老头，年轻人种灵药那可是非常少有的，一来没有经验，而来没有耐心，要知道有些灵药可是要许多个年头才能种成熟的。

沈天虎也是第一次看见有一个十来岁的小屁孩要种灵药，不过他看见沈翔那双带着自信光芒的眸子，也忍痛掏出了一个储物袋。

“如果你是闹着玩，我会打烂你的屁股，让你一个月内觉得坐凳子都是噩梦。”沈天虎阴沉一笑，让沈翔打了一个寒颤。

“三千大灵钱！如果你没有信心让这三千大灵钱翻倍的话，以后就别问我要钱了。”沈天虎拿出了一张经过特殊制造的灵钱票。

沈翔笑着接过来，说道：“放心吧，我可是一个要成为沈家最年轻炼丹师的男人！”

沈天虎心中一惊，他自然知道现在的沈翔已经不是那个没有灵脉的沈翔了，他心中也暗暗欢喜着，如果真是那样的话，那么将会让沈家更加强大，要知道沈家已经多年没有出过炼丹师了。

沈天虎大笑一声：“那赶紧滚蛋去折腾吧，你不给我弄出点什么花样来，你就等着挨揍吧！我去帮你回应药家。”

沈翔拿到三千大灵钱，匆匆离开了。

Late at night, on the top of a high mountain in the forest, there was a flash of green light. From a distance, it looked like a star descending on the top of the mountain.In order to prevent the strange phenomena caused by cultivation from being discovered, Chen Xiang went to a remote mountain forest to practice on the pretext of collecting medicine.

In order to absorb more spiritual energy and to sense the wind and thunder between heaven and earth, Chen Xiang climbed to the top of the mountain. At this time, he saw the clouds on the top of the mountain billowing and strong winds. Occasionally, the clouds flashed with thunder and lightning. The thunder and lightning fell straight down and hit the top of the mountain, as if it was going to split the mountain top.

This astonishing phenomenon was caused by Chen Xiang's practice of the Qinglong Divine Art.The strong wind, thunder and lightning were all caused by him practicing for a whole day. At this moment, the thunder and lightning struck his body, which not only tempered his body, but also allowed him to absorb the powerful power of thunder and lightning into his body.

This kind of behavior can be described as crazy. You must know that thunder and lightning are the most destructive celestial phenomena in nature. Even high-strength warriors who have entered the realm of true martial arts dare not face it casually. However, the Qinglong Divine Art practiced by Chen Xiang requires the assistance of sky thunder.

This strange scene lasted until midnight, and Chen Xiang's face, which was distorted by the pain, slowly recovered. The clothes on his body had been torn to pieces, and there were many black and smoking scars, but those scars were flashing green light, and the green light was repairing the injuries with a strong wood-attribute aura.

"What does this pain mean? I want to become stronger!" Chen Xiang clenched his fists and shouted in his heart, enduring the waves of lightning strikes, gritting his teeth and enduring the pain, letting the thunder and lightning temper his body.

It is indeed a magical skill. Not only can it cause visions, but it can also make the body withstand the strikes of thunder and lightning, beating the physical body and making it stronger.

A few days passed, and Chen Xiang's body seemed to be struck by lightning. At this time, he had completed basic body tempering!

Chen Xiang opened his eyes, and two bolts of lightning burst out from those determined eyes, which was truly astonishing.

"Mystical skills are magical skills, and they are indeed not comparable to ordinary martial arts! In just one month, I entered the fifth level of the ordinary martial arts realm!"

Chen Xiang looked inside at the five true energy vortices in his Dantian. As long as they were stronger, he could control the true energy at will. This would be the true energy realm of the fifth level of the mortal martial arts realm!

He is sixteen years old, possesses the strength of the fifth level of the Mortal Martial Realm, and is considered a genius!

Chen Xiang looked at the red and green Qi emerging from his hands. One was fire attribute Qi, and the other was wood attribute Qi.It shows that he has initially mastered the Qinglong Divine Art and the Suzaku Divine Art.

At this moment, Chen Xiang only felt as if he had been reborn. Both his physical body and his true energy were extremely powerful. After all, that was the true energy condensed from practicing magical skills, and the body was tempered by practicing magical skills.

Only then did Chen Xiang understand why magical skills are magical skills. They are skills that can allow people to become gods!

"The spiritual energy here is too poor. If you want to make rapid progress, you can only use elixirs! Now that you can release the fire of true energy, you can start learning alchemy." Su Meiyao said to him through a message.

Su Meiyao and Bai Youyou also hope that Chen Xiang can grow up quickly so that they can regain their strength as soon as possible. The situation without any strength frightens them.

"Hey, isn't this Mr. Shen? The genius alchemist of the Yao family has challenged you, saying that he wants to compete with you in alchemy and martial arts."

As soon as Chen Xiang stepped through the door of the Shen family, he saw an arrogant young man saying to him.

"Challenge? When did it happen?" Chen Xiang was surprised. He had been out for more than ten days.

那少年不屑地笑道：“原来你是不知道，我们还以为你是怕才躲起来的！这是十天前的事情，谁让你那未婚妻被人家药家天才看中了？这下你倒霉了。”

沈翔有想揍人的冲动，但他却忍了下来，笑道：“沈振华，你还记得你小时候被我摔得个狗吃屎吗？你现在来该不会是要想看我出丑吧？”

这少年名叫沈振华，是沈家一个分支统领的儿子，沈家的分支很多，遍布南武国各地，那些统领也十分强悍，只有一些重要的事情他们才会聚集到这沈家山庄中的。

Shen Zhenhua's face was full of anger, but he endured it and said with a sneer: "Of course I came to see how you were defeated by the genius of the Yao family. I really want to see how you lost your fiancée who is as beautiful as a fairy."

Chen Xiang snorted and left quickly to find his father. On his way back, he heard that something happened to the Shen family, so the branch leaders would come back.

Chen Xiang hurried in and asked hurriedly: "Dad, grandpa has stepped down from the position of clan leader. Is this true?"

Shen Tianhu looked solemn and nodded: "It's true! Your grandfather has retired. He should go to look for those martial arts sects. The leaders of the Shen family branches will arrive here one after another to compete for the position of clan leader."

The head of the Shen family abdicated, which meant that a new leader had to be elected. A lot of things might happen at that time, because there have been many battles over the years when the Shen family chose the head of the family, and injuries were inevitable.

When you become the patriarch of a martial arts family, you can control supreme power and have abundant resources, which many people will fight to the death for.

Chen Xiang's father will also compete for the position of clan leader. When the time comes, Chen Xiang will definitely be involved. If he does not have the strength, it will be quite dangerous.

The position of the patriarch of the Shen family has never been inherited, it is all obtained through competition. After all, this is a world where strength is respected. Only by showing strong strength can others be convinced. Therefore, if you want to be the patriarch of the Shen family, you can conquer others with force.

Chen Xiang saw Chen Tianhu's serious expression and asked cautiously: "Dad...is it difficult?"

Shen Tianhu sighed softly and said: "It's very difficult. There will be several people competing with me for the position of clan leader. Among them, there are two brothers who I am most worried about... Let's not talk about it anymore. The genius of the Yao family has challenged you. You can reject him."

Refuse?Chen Xiang never thought of rejecting the challenge since he learned about it. He is now a warrior at the fifth level of the Mortal Martial Realm, and he also possesses magical skills. Because he practices Tai Chi divine skills and restrains his aura, Chen Tianhu cannot notice that his son has made rapid progress.

"Dad, I will never let the Xue family and the Yao family look down upon me! I want to challenge!" Chen Xiang's eyes were firm and full of fighting intent. A burst of pure and pure energy suddenly emerged from his body. This made Chen Tianhu's pupils shrink and he was shocked. He could tell from that energy that his son was no longer what he used to be.

Shen Tianhu could imagine what must have happened to his son, but he didn't ask too many questions. He was also very happy to see his son become stronger.

Shen Tianhu put his big hand on Shen Xiang's shoulder and laughed and said: "Dad supports you, you must let the geniuses of the medicine family know what it means to be outside the world!"

Chen Xiang laughed dryly and said: "Dad, can you support me with some money?"

Although Chen Xiang has a powerful father, he himself is very poor, and his father is worried that he will become a playboy, so he has always let him live a simple life, which makes the grandson of the patriarch look very poor.

Although Chen Tianhu was powerful, he also spent a lot of money to improve his strength and help Chen Xiang collect pills, so he did not allow Chen Xiang to spend money randomly.

"I want to buy some elixirs to plant." Chen Xiang whispered, rolling his eyes.

Planting elixirs is a job that requires a lot of experience and requires careful care. Generally, people who plant elixirs are also alchemists, and they are all old men with gray hair. It is very rare for young people to grow elixirs. They have no experience, and then they have no patience. You must know that some elixirs take many years to mature.

It was also the first time that Chen Tianhu saw a teenage boy trying to grow elixir, but when he saw Chen Xiang's confident eyes, he reluctantly took out a storage bag.

"If you are joking, I will spank your ass and make sitting on a stool a nightmare for a month." Shen Tianhu smiled darkly, which made Chen Xiang shudder.

"Three thousand spiritual money! If you don't have the confidence to double this three thousand spiritual money, don't ask me for money in the future." Shen Tianhu took out a specially made spiritual money ticket.

Chen Xiang took it with a smile and said, "Don't worry, I am a man who wants to become the youngest alchemist of the Shen family!"

Chen Tianhu was shocked. He naturally knew that the current Chen Xiang was no longer the Chen Xiang without spiritual veins. He was also secretly happy in his heart. If that were the case, it would make the Shen family stronger. You must know that the Shen family has not produced an alchemist for many years.

Shen Tianhu laughed loudly: "Then get out of here and go to work. If you don't come up with something for me, just wait to be beaten! I'll help you respond to the Yao family."

Chen Xiang received three thousand spiritual coins and left in a hurry.
